data.title: 堀京子 · 发廊前的犹豫
data.description: （后期短发伏笔）商业街发廊橱窗前，她驻足看着短发造型的海报，抬手比划自己剪掉长发的位置；神情在期待与不舍之间，是角色时间线的重要瞬间。
data.action: 看短发海报，抬手比量自己剪去长发后的长度。
data.promptProse: Kyouko Hori pauses at the salon window on the shopping street, looking at a short-hair styling poster and raising a hand to measure where her long chestnut hair would be cut. Her white wing-collar shirt, dark blazer and pleated skirt remain neat. The medium portrait shows poster reflection beside her undecided face. Soft light reveals the held hair and window frame, with a faint reflected street behind the glass.
